upstream_claim: test_inference_writes_outputs: per-sample structure + confidence files written, one MSA run directory of the mode-appropriate kind. No accuracy expectation declared for this case.
adaptation: The file-existence assertion names upstream's own layout (msas/<run>/{main,dummy}, <query>/seed_<seed>/timing.json, <stem>_confidences.json, <stem>_confidences_aggregated.json, <stem>_model.cif). tt-bio writes openfold3_results_<query>/structures/<query>.cif plus a results.json confidence record, so the portable form of the claim is checked: one structure per diffusion sample and a confidence record, in both modes.
note: The leading X of the leucine-zipper sequence (XRMKQLEDKVEELLSKNYHLENEVARLKKLVGER) is accepted by the port's featurization, not rejected: both chains fold, 68 residues over 2 chains. That was an open risk before this run.
